presets.name: Puppies
presets.summary: Round muzzles and big glossy or button eyes.
presets.description: The round muzzle is the shortest of the six, and the puppy and button eyes are the two youngest of the ten eye sets. Ears, coat and everything else keep varying.

presets.name: Floppy Ears
presets.summary: Ears that hang: drop, long and curly.
presets.description: Three of the eight ear shapes lie on the head as flaps: the labrador's drop ear, the basset's long ear down past the chin, and the poodle's ear of curls.

presets.name: Pointed Ears
presets.summary: Ears that stand: prick and bat.
presets.description: The shepherd's tall prick ear and the broad, round bat ear of a corgi or a french bulldog. Both stand behind the skull with a darker inside.

presets.name: One Up, One Down
presets.summary: One ear stands, the other tips over.
presets.description: The mongrel's ear: a prick ear on one side and a folded one on the other. The muzzle, the coat and the hair still vary.

presets.name: Long Noses
presets.summary: The long muzzle with the nose low on every dog.
presets.description: The collie's and the shepherd's muzzle: a bridge from between the eyes down past the chin. A white blaze runs into it without a seam.

presets.name: Flat Faces
presets.summary: Short or heavy muzzles under small ears.
presets.description: The dark mask of a pug and the flews of a boxer, under ears that stay small or stand like a french bulldog's.

presets.name: Scruffy
presets.summary: Beards, fluffy muzzles and hair on every head.
presets.description: The schnauzer's beard with its brows or the doodle's cloud of a muzzle, and always a tuft, a topknot or bangs on top.

presets.name: Tricolour
presets.summary: Dark sides or a cap, and a white blaze between them.
presets.description: A dark marking and a white one on every dog, the way a beagle, a bernese or a husky wears them. The fur colour decides what the three tones are.

presets.name: Plain Coats
presets.description: Neither a dark marking nor a white one. The lighter muzzle stays, it is part of the muzzle and not of the coat.

presets.name: Playtime
presets.summary: A toy on the ground next to every dog.
presets.description: A ball, a stick, a bone or a frisbee lies in the corner three times out of ten. This makes it every dog. The frisbee takes the collar's colour.

presets.name: Bandanas
presets.description: Dogs wear a collar six times out of ten, and one collar in four is a bandana. This makes it every dog, in the four collar colours.

presets.name: Bare Neck
presets.description: Turns the collar off, tags and bandanas included.

presets.name: Indoors
presets.summary: Living room or kitchen behind the dog.
presets.description: The two rooms of the seven scenes: the living room the pets share and the kitchen with the bowl.

presets.name: Outdoors
presets.summary: Meadow, forest, yard, street or beach behind the dog.
presets.description: The five scenes under open sky, from the meadow and the forest the pets share to the yard with the kennel, the street and the beach.

presets.name: Studio
presets.summary: No scene, a flat pale ground instead.
presets.description: Turns the scene off and puts a pale background colour in its place, for avatars that sit on a coloured page.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.summary: Grey fur on a grey ground, scene and toys off.
presets.description: Every colour slot in grey and the scene off. The ball and the stick have colours of their own, so the toys are off as well.

presets.name: Animated
presets.summary: Turns the style's built-in animation on.
presets.description: The head tilts slowly from side to side and the tail wags, faster than a cat's.
